acceptance_criteria.description: Lua accepts address projection schema 3, rejects stale schema 2 with an accurate outer-schema diagnostic, and continues independently rejecting nested save schema values other than 1.
Launcher session and Phase 2 smoke manifest fixtures use outer schema 3 and the exact complete emulator identity object without changing save/ABI/protocol versions.

Current operator and requirements documentation describes launcher-owned executable identity validation, address-only Lua projection, exact supported artifact, and unresolved real interactive conformance honestly.
Lua tests, launcher formatting, diff checks, and all dependency-independent focused checks pass; dependency-blocked Rust outcomes are reported explicitly for root integration.

closed_decisions: The outer bridge manifest schema becomes 3 because it now binds the exact official mGBA 0.10.5 Windows x64 Qt artifact. Save schema, bridge ABI, game protocol, ROM identity, and regional identity registry versions remain unchanged.

Lua receives only a generated schema-3-compatible address projection. It must reject stale outer schema 2, continue requiring nested save schema 1, and must not receive or claim to validate host executable digests.

Launcher and smoke JSON fixtures must contain the complete exact emulator object required by the deny-unknown full manifest parser: name mGBA, version 0.10.5, platform windows-x64, variant Qt, archive SHA-256 b497a57c7d9093834dadc64f33a90f7c411439c21fdb8a0143255a45ea37563a, and executable SHA-256 5a3c98c2984dd04bd0d7c9378cdfae937ae0d73a196c880bb2eecf3b254af247.

Historical orchestration evidence remains immutable. Reconcile only current requirements, operator documentation, and blocker status without claiming real interactive mGBA conformance before it is demonstrated.
This unit is a staged dependency of the mGBA containment patch. It may leave full Rust tests pending until root applies both patches to the integration candidate.

read_only_prefixes: rtk rg -n schema_version bridge coop docs

forbidden_changes: Do not edit generator, dist manifest, compatibility parser, containment implementation, sidecar, protocol, cloud/server/save, ROM C code, Cargo manifests, or orchestration artifacts outside owned_files.
Do not add emulator metadata to the Lua projection, bump nested save schema 1, alter bridge ABI/protocol values, rewrite historical evidence, or claim that executable validation happens in Lua.
Do not stage, commit, branch, fetch, pull, push, contact Git remotes, create/remove worktrees, or revert edits made by another worker.
objective: Migrate every non-generator consumer and operator surface from bridge manifest schema 2 to schema 3, while preserving nested save schema 1 and documenting that Lua receives an address-only projection rather than executable identity metadata.

return_when: Every acceptance criterion is resolved and every required verification command has a recorded outcome.
A required consumer change needs an edit outside owned_files or conflicts with another worker's live edit.
